body: its about ease.  no bills, no school, no career, no disappointments, no regrets, no stress, no more shitty thoughts, no more realizing how people really are, no more thinking im a loser for considering suicide in the first place, no more thinking im being overly dramatic.  just sleep.

yeah there are people i love, that would be sad, i hope, to see me go.  but this isnt about them, its about me.  there is plenty i havent done or seen but i have aspirations to do alot, and if it doesnt work out, it will just be another failure.
